research_question: Does the frozen MLCNN classification plus IQ-Grouped parameter route retain its full-12-parameter advantage over MLCNN-global on entirely new receiver-noise identities?
single_changed_axis: receiver_noise_seed identities; model structure, optimizer, losses, checkpoint rule and thresholds procedure remain frozen from P4a

data.test_generation: train split only; no test MAT may be generated or opened

training.threshold_calibration: per-class F1 grid on calibration role only

stop_rule: Do not change data size, power, split, model, schedule, checkpoint objective or gates after opening the confirm role. If a critical gate fails, do not tune on seed510000000; retain P4a as optimization-seed evidence only.
next_if_pass: Freeze P4b and run two completely new generator seeds as no-tuning confirmation, then add a strictly MAC-matched shared-backbone control.
evidence_boundary: Fresh synthetic receiver-noise identities at 30 dB only; not nine-power, parameter OOD, long-tail, composition-disjoint or locked-test evidence.
